sources.fact: LBBD Regulation 19 Cabinet HTML lists XQ - Former Volunteer Public House, Alfred's Way as a site-allocation attachment.
Cabinet approved publication of the Regulation 19 submission Local Plan; this is plan-making provenance, not site permission.
LBBD states the Local Plan 2037 was adopted on 18 September 2024.
The adopted Local Plan forms part of the Development Plan used to assess planning applications.
Be First provides statutory planning services and current planning application search for LBBD.
LBBD distinguishes planning policy/application services from local land charge/title-related searches.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission; allocation alone is not consent.
Official land-charge searches require a site location plan for accurate land/property identification.
Local Land Charges searches concern legal restrictions/obligations and are kept separate from allocation identity.
CIL liability follows permission/development circumstances and is not evidence that XQ has permission.
LBBD's current street-tree schedule includes Alfreds Way; street identity is not a site/title boundary.
No exact current XQ residential application/decision was verified from accessible official HTML this wave.

examples.result: XQ allocation identity is revalidated from LBBD HTML.
Regulation 19 publication approval is plan-making, not site planning permission.
Adoption of the Local Plan does not create an individual site consent.
Alfreds Way street identity is not converted into a red-line or HMLR polygon.
No exact current residential case is guessed from allocation identity.
Local-land-charge process is not substituted for HMLR title verification.
Promotion remains zero until exact current case, title relation and overlays are verified.
